description: Hand-authored retrieval sanity set. Each query has one labelled passage; not a benchmark of the user's documents.

cases.query: Can I still find my files when the network drive is disconnected?
cases.text: Offline search retains previously indexed filenames and passages from an unavailable NAS. Reconnecting the share restores access to the original files.

cases.query: Where did we explain why the launcher's missing my locally built app?
cases.text: Application discovery only scanned the standard Applications directories. A development bundle stored inside a project's dist directory was registered with macOS but absent from our app catalog.

cases.query: Which report explains the money we spent above the plan?
cases.text: The quarterly budget variance report compares actual expenditure with approved forecasts. Contractor fees and equipment purchases account for most of the overspend.

cases.query: How do I get back text that I accidentally erased?
cases.text: Document version history retains earlier revisions. Select a saved revision and restore it to recover a deleted paragraph or an accidental edit.

cases.query: What happens if indexing crashes in the middle?
cases.text: Filesystem events and their checkpoint commit together in a durable queue. After an unexpected shutdown, workers replay pending changes and acknowledge only successfully completed work.

cases.query: Who agreed to do the remaining work before launch?
cases.text: The meeting minutes assign release tasks to owners. Priya will finish the onboarding copy, Mateo will validate exports, and Sam will resolve the final accessibility defects.

cases.query: What did the experiment show after accounting for differences between groups?
cases.text: The analysis estimated the adjusted association using a regression model with baseline covariates. The sensitivity analysis repeated the estimate after excluding incomplete observations.

cases.query: Why did the paper get sent back instead of accepted?
cases.text: The editor requested major revisions. Reviewers asked for clearer inclusion criteria, additional robustness checks, and a discussion of limitations before reconsidering the manuscript.

cases.query: How can the entire team use the same project setup?
cases.text: The reproducibility guide pins dependency versions and records the interpreter release. A lockfile and a documented environment installation command keep collaborators' installations consistent.

cases.query: Which document covers who owns what we build together?
cases.text: The collaboration agreement specifies intellectual property ownership. Each party retains prior inventions while rights to jointly developed deliverables follow the negotiated assignment terms.

cases.query: Where are the arrangements for getting to the conference?
cases.text: The travel itinerary lists outbound flights, airport transfers, hotel check-in dates, and the venue address. Booking references and the return journey appear on the final page.

cases.query: How do we bring back the database after the server fails?
cases.text: The disaster recovery procedure restores the latest verified database backup and replays transaction logs. Operators validate record counts and application health before resuming traffic.

cases.query: Why is typing in the search box so slow?
cases.text: The performance profile shows document extraction blocking the search executor. Moving parsing and filesystem operations to background workers reduces interactive query latency.

cases.query: Where can I find the answers people gave to our questionnaire?
cases.text: The survey response spreadsheet contains one row per participant and one column per question. The coding guide explains missing values and the scale used for each answer.

cases.query: How do we prevent an employee who has left from accessing company systems?
cases.text: The offboarding checklist revokes account sessions, disables identity-provider access, removes group memberships, and rotates any shared credentials associated with the departing employee.

cases.query: Which notes describe reducing the amount of personal information we retain?
cases.text: The data minimization plan inventories collected fields, removes unnecessary identifiers, and sets retention periods. Expired records are deleted according to the documented disposal schedule.
